name: ssn-unified
description: SSN Unified - modernized front-end monorepo (hub + satellite apps) with a shared mock backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,HUB,COE,LMS,LIB,GATE,HELP,ERP -c blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan,red,white,gray "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w apps/hub" "npm run dev -w apps/coe" "npm run dev -w apps/lms" "npm run dev -w apps/library" "npm run dev -w apps/gatepass" "npm run dev -w apps/helpdesk" "npm run dev -w apps/erp"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w apps/hub && npm run build -w apps/coe && npm run build -w apps/lms && npm run build -w apps/library && npm run build -w apps/gatepass && npm run build -w apps/helpdesk && npm run build -w apps/erp
